title: Lesson 1: Ohm's Law
goal: The resistor draws about 29mA right now, past the safe 25mA target. Get the battery current down to 25mA or less by adding resistance.
hints: Ohm's law: current = voltage / total resistance. More series resistance means less current.
The battery's own internal resistance (0.5 ohm) counts too, but it is tiny compared to your resistors.
Wire a second 100 ohm resistor in series: end-to-end in the same loop, not side by side.
